elements.requirement: A person (A) discriminates against another person (B) if, because of a protected characteristic, person A treats person B less favourably than person A treats or would treat others.
elements.quote: A treats B less favourably than A treats or would treat others

elements.requirement: If the protected characteristic is age, person A does not discriminate against person B if person A can show that person A's treatment of person B is a proportionate means of achieving a legitimate aim.
elements.quote: proportionate means of achieving a legitimate aim

elements.requirement: If the protected characteristic is disability and person B is not a disabled person, person A does not discriminate against person B only because person A treats or would treat disabled persons more favourably than person A treats person B.
elements.quote: only because A treats or would treat disabled persons more favourably than A treats B

elements.requirement: If the protected characteristic is marriage and civil partnership, section 13 of the Equality Act 2010 applies to a contravention of Part 5 (work) only if the treatment is because person B is married or a civil partner.
elements.quote: only if the treatment is because it is B who is married or a civil partner

elements.requirement: If the protected characteristic is race, less favourable treatment includes segregating person B from others.
If the protected characteristic is sex, less favourable treatment of a woman includes less favourable treatment of her because she is breast-feeding.
elements.quote: less favourable treatment of her because she is breast-feeding

elements.requirement: If the protected characteristic is sex and person B is a man, no account is to be taken of special treatment afforded to a woman in connection with pregnancy, childbirth, or maternity.
elements.quote: no account is to be taken of special treatment afforded to a woman in connection with pregnancy , childbirth or maternity

elements.requirement: Section 13 of the Equality Act 2010 is subject to sections 17(6) and 18(7).
elements.quote: This section is subject to sections 17(6) and 18(7)
